plainText:
Marc Diraison is an American voice actor, ADR director and script writer for the English dub of .

==Biography==
Diraison first joined the series in the eighth season. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, he left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. He later returned in Steeling Peace of Mind!.
